title: What comic formats does TV Comic Book Reader support?
content: The app supports CBZ, ZIP, CBR, RAR, CB7, 7Z, CBT, and TAR comic archives on Android TV.

title: How can I import comics into the app?
content: You can import comics with Web Import, WiFi Import, or FTP Import. The app can also open compatible comic archives shared from other apps.

title: Does Web Import require my phone or computer to be on the same network as the TV?
content: No. Web Import uses a temporary token and QR code, so it can work even when the sending device is not on the same local network.

title: When should I use WiFi Import?
content: Use WiFi Import when your Android TV and the sending device are on the same network. It provides a local upload page and QR code for quick transfers.

title: How does FTP Import work?
content: FTP Import is designed for same-network transfers from a computer or another device. It supports anonymous login for quick setup.

title: Does the app create thumbnails for my comics?
content: Yes. TV Comic Book Reader generates visual thumbnails from comic pages so you can browse your library and bookmarks more easily.

title: Can I change how pages look while reading?
content: Yes. You can zoom in or out, change fit mode, rotate pages, enable night mode or color inversion, and choose a background color for more comfortable reading.

title: Is there a gallery view for browsing pages?
content: Yes. The app includes a gallery or strip view that lets you browse pages visually and jump back into the reader from the selected page.

title: Does the app remember my reading progress?
content: Yes. The app saves your reading progress per comic and also remembers reader settings such as zoom, rotation, background color, and night mode.

title: How do bookmarks work?
content: You can add bookmarks for specific pages, open a bookmark list for the current comic, or browse all saved bookmarks from the dedicated bookmarks screen. Bookmark entries also include page thumbnails.

title: Can I delete imported comics or clear app data?
content: Yes. You can long-press an imported comic to view details or delete it, and the settings screen includes tools to clear imported comics, thumbnails, and bookmarks.

title: Does TV Comic Book Reader work offline?
content: Yes. Once your comics are imported or available on the device, you can browse and read them without an internet connection.

title: Is the app available in multiple languages?
content: Yes. The app includes translations for multiple languages, including Arabic, Chinese, French, German, Hindi, Italian, Japanese, Korean, Portuguese, Russian, Spanish, Thai, Turkish, Vietnamese, and Indonesian.
